root.label: Mortgage applications fall in week ending September 25 2026

events.label: Mortgage applications fall in week ending September 25 2026

slots.name: application decline
slots.sentence: Mortgage applications, which include loans to buy a home or refinance an existing mortgage, tumbled 6% last week from the previous week, according to the Mortgage Bankers Association.

slots.name: ARM application share
slots.sentence: Such loans, which typically offer lower initial interest rates than traditional 30-year, fixed-rate mortgages, accounted for more than 10% of all mortgage applications last week, MBA said.

slots.name: refinance application pace
slots.sentence: Home loan refinance applications fell last week to their lowest level since January 2025 and were less than half last year’s pace, according to the MBA.
